market_sources.quality: Third-party free, undocumented public endpoint; not an exchange feed, no SLA. Unadjusted day OHLC price indices. Volume units are provider-specific and not compared across providers.
Same third-party vendor, not independent corroboration. Live probe returned a rolling 640-row window despite supplied dates; local date filtering is mandatory. No guaranteed old-history coverage.
Third-party free, undocumented public daily endpoint (scale=240); latest 1023 observations only, not exchange-certified. Price precision and volume units differ from Tencent. Never splice providers.

global_market_sources.quality: Third-party public undocumented chart endpoint. Validate INDEX/USD/America_New_York identity and daily granularity. Null OHLC stays missing; quote/regularMarketPrice never fills a historical candle. No SLA; volume units not interpreted.

Third-party undocumented daily index endpoint, verified live 2026-09-23. Payload has no symbol/timezone field; identity is the fixed verified provider symbol mapping. New York regular-session dates are checked against the exchange calendar. No guarantee of exchange-final prices; no provider splicing or volume interpretation.
Same vendor as query1, not independent corroboration. Entire series fallback only; identical symbol/type/timezone and missing-row checks apply.

spot_market_sources.quality: Official public wholesale spot midpoint chart reference, not executable trade, CFD, futures or LBMA fixing. Epoch timestamps are bucket STARTS. Short windows use 14400s (six 4-hour buckets per UTC day, about 30 days); longer windows use 43200s (two 12-hour buckets, about 90 days). Each entire series uses one resolution with complete buckets and a pre-period baseline, never spliced. Open unavailable; exact final tick time unknown. USD/kg converted by documented 0.0311034768 kg/troy_oz. Flat days may carry quotes through closures, not proof of active trading. Optional websockets>=15,<17; missing dependency fails explicitly. No exchange-close certification or SLA.

spot_candidates.quality: Uncertified spot candidate. Live CSV requests returned browser verification HTML; no challenge bypass. Provider daily cutoff remains unverified. Never admitted as usable OHLC.

Official chart documents wholesale spot midpoint reference quotes. Public CSV exposes HLC in USD/kg and USD/troy oz, not Open. Do not fabricate OHLC from previous close or treat sampled intervals as a certified daily session.
Provider explicitly labels XAU/XAG London gold/silver CFDs. Daily OHLC exists, but CFD basis and unverified daily cutoff fail requested spot_price identity. Excluded under both quality policies.
Uncertified currency-code candidate; live requests returned HTTP 404. GC=F/SI=F futures and GLD/SLV ETFs are not substitutes.

document_sources.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China
document_sources.quality: First-party official macro releases in Chinese. Publication date is not the economic observation period. Recent listing only; no exhaustive archive claim.

document_sources.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (English)
document_sources.quality: First-party official English releases, an alternative entry point on the same authority, not independent corroboration. Translation publication dates may differ from Chinese. Recent listing only.
First-party official speeches. Views belong to the named speaker, not necessarily the Board or FOMC. Feed plus bounded annual-list fallback; not comprehensive research coverage.

document_sources.publisher: Bank for International Settlements (central-bank speech republication)
document_sources.quality: Official BIS-hosted republications of named central bankers, NOT BIS institutional endorsement. Website publication date may differ from delivery date in the preserved text. Conservatively reject speech pages linking a publication PDF because HTML may be only an excerpt; recent RSS only.

global_document_sources.quality: First-party monetary-policy press releases. Official RSS dates and full #article text; projection PDFs/images/attachments not extracted. Bounded recent feed only; do not infer causality from publication timing.

limitations: 公共接口可能变更或失效，可用性仅代表抓取时的实测结果，不保证持续可用。
仅支持配置中的境内外价格指数及现货金银参考价，不提供个股、全收益或投资业绩结论。成交量原始单位未确认，不解释或跨源比较。
基准最多向前查找45个自然日。全球指数按交易日历核验，缺库或超范围不以工作日代替；境内历史区间兼容路径不承诺完整交易日历。
金银为UTC完整采样日末参考价，非官方收盘或精确午夜成交价。短区间用六个4小时桶（约30天），月度等较长区间用两个12小时桶（约90天）；整段同一颗粒度，不拼接，须有完整采样与期前基准。开盘价为null，静止日可能沿用报价，不能证明新交易日。
文章按发布日期筛选，仅为有数量上限的官方资料样本，不是完整宏观数据库。保留未截断的 HTML 正文和文本表格，不提取图片、PDF 或附件内容。
2026-09-22 实测 IMF Blogs 返回 HTTP 403；Fed 和 BIS 为可用替代入口，但不能替代 IMF 自身的观点证据。
共享 fetch_url 限制套接字超时和响应大小，但无法对系统 DNS 解析或持续缓慢响应强制实行总超时；采集预算耗尽后不再发起新请求。
